def test_detalle_softrestaurant_usa_apertura_y_turno_cerrado():
    text = DETAIL.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    block = text[text.index('def _extract_soft('):text.index('def _mpro_operational_datetime_range')]
    assert 'INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK)' in block
    assert 'tr.idturno = ch.idturno' in block
    assert 'tr.idempresa = ch.idempresa' in block
    assert 'ch.idempresa = %s' in block
    assert 'tr.idempresa = %s' in block
    assert 'tr.apertura >= %s' in block
    assert 'tr.apertura < %s' in block
    assert 'tr.cierre IS NOT NULL' in block
    assert 'WHERE ch.fecha >= %s' not in block
    assert 'tr.cierre >= %s' not in block
    assert 'tr.cierre < %s' not in block


def test_idempresa_se_descubre_en_pos_y_falla_cerrado():
    text = DETAIL.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    helper = text[text.index('def _softrestaurant_empresa_id_for_window'):text.index('def _extract_soft(')]
    assert 'SELECT DISTINCT' in helper
    assert 't.idempresa' in helper
    assert 't.apertura >= %s' in helper

    assert 't.cierre IS NOT NULL' in helper

def test_pagos_ticket_softrestaurant_usa_apertura_y_turno_cerrado():
    text = ENRICH.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    start = text.index('def _extract_softrestaurant(')
    end = text.index('def _extract_mpro(')
    soft = text[start:end]
    assert soft.count("WHERE t.apertura >= '{fi}' AND t.apertura < '{ff}'") == 2

def test_ejecutivo_conserva_contrato_oficial_por_apertura():
    text = HEADER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    start = text.index('QUERY_SOFTRESTAURANT_VENTAS_CERRADAS_DIA =')
    end = text.index('def build_softrestaurant_ventas_cerradas_query')
    query = text[start:end]
